thread:
marie: Quick heads-up — pen test retest handoff. We need a 2-hr RBAC change window + KMS grant rotation and confirmation of log sampling before handover. Who can own evidence scrub & presigned upload? @josh @alex @samir

josh: I can own the RBAC window. Planning to swap ephemeral roles at 21:00 UTC. Need the exact resource list (roles, groups, service principals). Also: how long do we keep assessor creds live? 1 hour?

marie: yes 1h max. We'll create a runbook entry and set a hard TTL.

alex: For KMS — do we want to create a short-lived grant via the KMS proxy or rotate the key? Recommend creating a grant scoped to the testing principal + TTL 1h. That avoids full key rotation and reduces blast radius.

samir: Agreed. Also need a log-sampling plan: we keep full request logs, but must scrub PII before handing. Suggest these steps: (1) run sampling query, (2) redact sensitive fields, (3) generate proof archive (hashed + timestamps).

anna: I'll schedule the retest slot: Tue 2026-04-07 21:00 UTC. I'll provide presigned S3 link for evidence upload. Who will produce the scrubbed artifacts?

marie: @samir + @josh. Samir will run redaction script. Josh will produce role-change audit and attach signed manifests.

samir: Draft scrub script (run against staging export):
```
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /redwood/api --start-time $START --end-time $END | jq '.events[] | {ts:.timestamp, msg:(.message | gsub("(?i)\\b(email|ssn|credit_card)\\b":"[REDACTED]"))}' > scrubbed.json
```

josh: For audit proofs I'm going to export CloudTrail + internal audit logs. We'll create a tarball, generate a sha256 manifest and sign with cosign before upload.

marie: Important: auditor requires a hash manifest and a time-range manifest. Use `sha256sum` over tarball and include a text file listing start/end timestamps and the role-change ops.

josh: noted. I'll add manifest and upload to the presigned link from anna.

security-oncall: Small note — ensure we revoke the KMS grant (not the key) after the window. Also add a CloudWatch metric filter to catch noise spikes during the test: `error_count > 50` alert suppressed for the window only.

anna: Presigned link created: https://s3.presigned/redwood-pt/slot-1718009999 (expires in 2h)

marie: Perfect. Also add a pointer to the audit-sample query used for sampling verification:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM requests
WHERE path LIKE '/api/v1/generate'
  AND timestamp BETWEEN $start AND $end
GROUP BY bin(5m)
```

samir: I'll run sampling and post the top 10 user-id hashed buckets for verification and the scrubbed sample rows (PII replaced).

marie: Thanks. Final checklist: RBAC window owner = josh, KMS grant owner = alex, scrub = samir, evidence upload = anna (presigned), manifests = josh, retention & alerting = security-oncall. Any blockers?

josh: one blocker — need approval from infra to create ephemeral roles in prod namespace. pinging @infra-team

infra-team: approved. :white_check_mark: We also recommend a short smoke test after role swap to validate access gates.

marie: Great. We'll proceed with that plan. I'll file this thread as the handoff record and link to the runbook. :thumbsup:
